title: Elf Bar Plus Banana Ice Prefilled Pod + Refill
description: Banana Ice combines a soft, creamy Banana flavour with an uplifting streak of cool Menthol for a rich and refreshing vape. The ripe Banana note lands with a mellow sweetness, while the icy exhale keeps the flavour clean and refreshing from first draw to last. Each Elf Bar Plus Prefilled Pod pack is supplied as a single prefilled 2ml pod paired with an 8ml refill container, giving a total of 10ml of 20mg Nic Salt e-liquid. There’s no messy refilling and no coil changes. Just connect the pod and reservoir, fit the assembled unit to the Elf Bar Plus 12 or 50 Prefilled Pod Kit, and vape. The pod uses an advanced 0.8ohm QUAQ mesh coil and draw-activated inhale to deliver consistently smooth flavour and discreet MTL vapour. One pod pack can deliver up to 12,000 puffs, depending on personal use. When performance drops or the reservoir is empty, simply replace with a fresh Elf Bar Plus Prefilled Pod pack in your chosen flavour. Please Note: These Pods are compatible with Elf Bar Plus 12 & 50 Device
